description: Word problems with known numeric answers.
name: Math

tasks.prompt: A farmer has 17 apples. He gives away 5 and then buys 9 more. How many apples does he have now?
A train travels 60 miles per hour for 2.5 hours. How many miles does it travel?
Sara had 84 stickers. She shared them equally among 7 friends. How many stickers did each friend get?
A rectangle is 12 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its area in square cm?
